descriptionHtml:
**Arctic MX-4 Thermal Paste**


**Brand:** Arctic

**Model:** MX-4

**Type:** Non-electrical conductive thermal compound


**Thermal Conductivity:** 8.5 W/mK


**Viscosity:** 870 Poise


**Density:** 2.50 g/cm³


**Volume Options:** 4g 


**Operating Temperature Range:** -50°C to +150°C


**Electrical Conductivity:** No (non-electrical conductive)


**Capacitance:** Non-capacitive


**Cure Time:** 0 hours (no curing required)


**Application Method:** Spread with spatula or dot method


**Shelf Life:** 8 years (unopened)


**Composition:** Carbon microparticles


**Specific Gravity:** 2.5


**Surface Resistance:** >10¹³ Ω/cm


**Color:** Dark grey


**Features:**

- Metal-free (no risk of short circuits)

- No burn-in time required

- Easy to apply

- Excellent long-term stability

- Not electrically conductive


**Compatible with:**

- CPUs (Intel / AMD)

- GPUs (NVIDIA / AMD)

- Gaming consoles (PlayStation, Xbox)

- Laptops

- Cooling systems (air and liquid)


**Package includes:**

- Arctic MX-4 thermal paste

- Application spatula (depending on size)

- Cleaning cloth (depending on size)

- User manual


**Performance Notes:**

- Performs consistently across full temperature range

- No pump-out effect (does not thin out over time)

- Excellent for both high-end gaming PCs and office computers
